caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular glass enclosure with a sloped roof, all segments of which are framed in blue, red, and tan patterned borders. The enclosure is decorated with numerous red flowers on the glass panels and inside on the floor. Inside the enclosure, a human figure with dark hair, light brown skin, and wearing a bright yellow and red garment lies on a white pillow and sheet. The body is positioned horizontally, with a floral pattern on the chest and hand. The base of the enclosure is elaborately adorned with swirling floral patterns in shades of red, blue, and tan. The rest of the scene is set against a plain beige background.
title: Christ in Sepulchre
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
